# Memristive_Solutions

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
Techniques and architectures developed to mitigate memristive device threats, including error correction, redundancy, adaptive programming, or hybrid CMOS-memristor integration. These solutions are critical for enabling dependable and scalable iNEST implementations, where memristive devices serve as core synaptic or neuronal elements.
